// diagnostic

E0701

Non-`std` `extern rust` crate missing `@version` pin

What

Non-`std` `extern rust` crate missing `@version` pin

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0701

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0701: tests/ui/ffi_missing_version.stderr.

Error [E0701]: the crate `base64` needs a version pin
  --> tests/ui/ffi_missing_version.jet:1:13
    |
  1 | extern rust "base64" {
    |             ^^^^^^^^
 Why: every non-`std` `extern rust` crate must pin an exact version so builds stay reproducible
 Fix: write: extern rust "base64@0.1" { ... }
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0701

Error [E0102]: nothing named `b64encode` exists here
  --> tests/ui/ffi_missing_version.jet:6:18
    |
  6 | fn run() { print(b64encode("hi")) }
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: only functions that have been defined (or built in, like `print` / `input`) can be called
 Fix: define it first (fn b64encode() { ... }), or call one that exists
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0102
